topic: The assassination that almost didn't happen — three failed attempts in one day
hook: They tried to kill him three times. The fourth attempt worked.
script: They tried to kill him three times. The fourth attempt worked. On the day Franz Ferdinand was assassinated, one conspirator's bomb bounced off the car. Another got cold feet. A third missed completely. Ferdinand's own driver then took a wrong turn — straight past Gavrilo Princip. History doesn't turn on plans. It turns on accidents. Follow for history's darkest coincidences.
